translations.web: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
translations.bsb: All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
translations.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
translations.asv: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart hath a continual feast.
